style: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One standalone landscape 3:2 photograph, never a collage. Fictional modern Korean internal-medicine outpatient clinic in a new-town commercial building. Bright evenly exposed daylight and practical neutral recessed LED light, fresh white and warm ivory surfaces, restrained pale-oak cabinetry, powder-blue clinical upholstery and curtains, ordinary believable compact rooms and medical furniture, normal 2.7m ceilings and realistic air vents. Professional documentary healthcare photography with subtle natural material texture and fine sensor grain, realistic skin pores and anatomy when people are present, natural candid expressions. No huge atrium, luxury marble hotel, overly staged stock-photo grin, cinematic dark lighting, glossy CGI-render surfaces, excessive bokeh, readable text, identifiable brand labels, watermarks, names, certificates or claims. Keep equipment physically coherent and unbranded; inactive or oblique unreadable monitors. This is an AI-generated fictional demo facility.
